title: Preparation of Natural Peptidoglycan Nanoparticles and Purification of Plant-Derived Antigens
author: Meng, Ren, et al.

steps.title: Collect LAB cells
steps.instruction: Determine the optical density of the L. sakei culture, then centrifuge the culture at 8,000 × g for 10 min at room temperature and discard the supernatant.

substeps.instruction: Measure OD of bacterial culture.
Centrifuge at 8,000 × g for 10 min (RT).
Carefully discard supernatant.

steps.title: TCA treatment of cells
steps.instruction: Resuspend the bacterial pellet in 10 % (w/v) trichloroacetic acid (TCA) using enough volume to fully immerse the pellet (e.g., 5 mL TCA per 10 mL culture), incubate at 100 °C for 10 min, then cool to room temperature.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend pellet in 10 % w/v TCA (≈5 mL per 10 mL culture).
Incubate at 100 °C for 10 min (water bath or heating block).
Cool the suspension to room temperature.

steps.title: Wash out TCA
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 8,000 × g for 10 min, discard supernatant, and resuspend the pellet in TBS buffer; repeat this wash three times to remove residual TCA.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge 8,000 × g for 10 min.
Discard supernatant.
Resuspend pellet in TBS buffer.
Repeat the centrifuge‑discard‑resuspend cycle two more times (total three washes).

steps.title: Trypsin digestion
steps.instruction: Resuspend the washed BLP pellet in Tris buffer (50 mM, pH 7.8) containing trypsin at 2 µg mL⁻¹ and incubate at 37 °C for 2 h to degrade residual intracellular proteins.

substeps.instruction: Prepare Tris buffer 50 mM, pH 7.8 with trypsin 2 µg mL⁻¹.
Resuspend BLP pellet in this buffer.
Incubate at 37 °C for 2 h.

steps.title: Wash out trypsin and store NPN
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 8,000 × g for 10 min, discard supernatant, and resuspend the NPN pellet in TBS; then wash the pellet three times with sterile distilled water, finally resuspend at a concentration of 1 unit (derived from 1 mL culture at OD₆₀₀ = 1). Store short‑term at 4 °C or long‑term after autoclaving and sealing at room temperature.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge 8,000 × g for 10 min.
Discard supernatant.
Resuspend pellet in TBS buffer.
Wash pellet three times with sterile ddH₂O (resuspend → centrifuge → discard).
Resuspend final pellet to 1 unit per desired volume (1 unit = NPN from 1 mL culture at OD₆₀₀ = 1).
Store: short term at 4 °C; long term autoclave and keep sealed at room temperature.

steps.title: Harvest and grind leaf tissue
steps.instruction: Collect infiltrated Nicotiana benthamiana leaves, freeze immediately in liquid nitrogen, grind to a fine powder with a pre‑chilled mortar and pestle, and store the powder at –80 °C if not processed right away.

substeps.instruction: Harvest infiltrated N. benthamiana leaves.
Freeze samples in liquid nitrogen.
Grind frozen tissue to fine powder using a liquid‑nitrogen‑chilled mortar and pestle.
Store powder at –80 °C if delayed.

steps.title: Extract soluble proteins
steps.instruction: Transfer the leaf powder to a pre‑chilled tube, add protein extraction buffer at 10 mL per gram of tissue, homogenize thoroughly, centrifuge at 12,000–15,000 × g for 10 min at 4 °C, collect the clear supernatant, repeat centrifugation at least three times, filtering through Miracloth before each spin to remove fine debris.

substeps.instruction: Place powdered tissue in a pre‑chilled tube.
Add extraction buffer (10 mL g⁻¹ leaf tissue).
Homogenize until fully solubilized.
Centrifuge 12,000–15,000 × g for 10 min at 4 °C.
Collect supernatant.
Repeat centrifugation ≥3 times, filtering supernatant through Miracloth before each spin.

steps.title: Sterile filtration of protein extract
steps.instruction: Pass the final supernatant through a sterile 0.22 µm filter unit to remove any remaining particulate matter and bacterial contaminants (required only for therapeutic proteins intended for in vivo injection).

substeps.instruction: Set up sterile 0.22 µm filter unit.
Filter the protein extract.
Proceed only if sterility is required for the downstream application.

steps.title: NPN‑mediated protein purification
steps.instruction: Aliquot the filtered protein extract, add natural peptidoglycan nanoparticles at 1 unit per 2–5 mL extract, incubate on a shaker at 4 °C for 15 min, filter out the unbound fraction, wash the bound NPN‑protein complex three times with sterilized TBS, and finally resuspend in an appropriate buffer for in vivo injection or in‑vitro assays.

substeps.instruction: Aliquot filtered protein extract into sterile tubes.
Add NPN (1 unit per 2–5 mL extract).
Incubate at 4 °C for 15 min on a shaker.
Filter to collect the bound fraction.
Wash bound fraction three times with sterilized TBS buffer.
Resuspend purified protein in the desired buffer for downstream use.
